eligibility_text: Indian youth, especially early school/college leavers and the unemployed, who want short-term certified skill training. No fee for training or certification.
benefits: Free short-term training (typically 200-600 hours) aligned to National Skill Qualification Framework standards, a government-recognised certificate, and placement assistance through Skill India.
source_note: General knowledge, structurally stable scheme; verify current training-center list for the demo's target city.
